column4: cleat#3547: these tests build their shards from real PostgreSQL databases (newRealShards -> bootstrapScratchDB), and sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration -- no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists (same reason as a-workflow-def-is-replicated-to-every-shard.tsv, cleat#3545). They skip as bare test names, not a /postgres suffix. Five skips: the five top-level tests in a_concurrent_deploys_of_one_version_leave_the_shards_agreeing_test.go. multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so they skip here.

cleat#3547: same five tests, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. They run, and pass, under test-go/engine and cluster, which set the PostgreSQL DSN.
